sources.title: Original ImageGen concept sheet corresponding row
sources.notes: Aesthetic only. B concept ridge language retained, but its cut-out horseshoe base rejected. Use continuous irregular sandy terrain floor inside U blowout, taller rounded nose+Y with steep outer lee face and gently sloping inner windward face, long lower vegetated trailing arms-Y. No wind arrows in export. Outer footprint irregular octagonal clipped terrain with solid underside. Sparse low faceted olive plant patches along arms, not trees.
